author: blu
body: Proves flexible mana. "Add one mana of any color" (Birds of Paradise) compiles to a FlexManaAbility over all five colours; "Add {B} or {G}" (a Bayou) over {black, green}. When tapped, the engine makes the colour the controller needs: with a green spell in hand, Birds -- and the dual -- produce green. Dual lands and any-colour sources made no mana before.
